lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is irregular, with a notably wider gap between the second and third lines from the posterior than between the anterior groupings.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines 1, 2, 5, and 6 (counted from posterior) terminate mid-flank, failing to intersect with the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, positioned superior to the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A single horizontally elongated white marking is present on the posterior edge of the hindquarter, forming a short geometric line perpendicular to the vertical axis of the leg.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a divergent spiral geometry, initiating at approximately 55 degrees from the skull base, curving posteriorly and then medially toward the terminal apices.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.4 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 10-15% of the total vertical height of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a continuous white/cream dorsal mane extending from the poll to the rump. Distinct white 'sock' markings are visible on all four distal limbs, starting above the fetlock.
